metadata.title: New Jersey Food Pantries
metadata.description: A curated list of food pantries, food banks, and soup kitchens across New Jersey, organized by county. Includes regional/statewide distribution centers and local pantries.
metadata.note: Hours and contact information are subject to change. Always call ahead to confirm availability and eligibility requirements.

regional_food_banks.name: Community FoodBank of New Jersey – Main (Southern Branch)
regional_food_banks.notes: Does not generally serve the public directly; partners with regional pantries across NJ. Text 'FindFood' to 908-224-7776 to locate partner pantries.

regional_food_banks.name: Community FoodBank of New Jersey – Hillside Branch
regional_food_banks.notes: Feeding America partner. Partners with 800+ agencies statewide. Offers Nutrition Education, Cooking Classes, and baby pantry.

regional_food_banks.name: Food Bank of South Jersey
regional_food_banks.notes: Works with 300+ partner agencies. Offers drive-thru food banks, holiday food baskets, SNAP outreach, and Farm 2 School programs.

regional_food_banks.name: Fulfill (Food Bank of Monmouth & Ocean Counties)
regional_food_banks.notes: Feeding America partner. Offers free fruits, vegetables, dairy, meats, baby formula, SNAP enrollment assistance.

regional_food_banks.name: Mercer Street Friends Food Bank
regional_food_banks.notes: Also provides SNAP and WIC referrals. Additional location at 824 Sylvia St., Ewing, NJ 08628. Phone: 609-406-0503.

regional_food_banks.name: NORWESCAP Food Bank
regional_food_banks.notes: Community action agency. Provides food boxes, holiday meals, SNAP applications, baby formula, and senior assistance.

regional_food_banks.name: Philabundance
regional_food_banks.notes: Headquartered in PA but serves southern NJ. Offers Senior Brown Bag/Food Box Distribution, WIC vouchers, SNAP Outreach, and free pet food bank.

regional_food_banks.name: Food Bank Network of Somerset County
regional_food_banks.notes: Provides perishable and canned goods to children, seniors, and low-income families. Offers holiday meals.

Atlantic.name: Community FoodBank of NJ – Atlantic County Mobile Pantries
Atlantic.address: Various Locations (Egg Harbor City, Galloway, Absecon, Pleasantville, Egg Harbor Township)
Atlantic.notes: Mobile pantry serving Atlantic County motel locations and surrounding areas.

Bergen.name: St. Cecilia Church / Office of Concern
Bergen.notes: Provides free food, hygiene items, baby formula. Processes WIC applications. Serves immigrants and Spanish speakers.

Bergen.name: Center for Food Action – Englewood
Bergen.notes: Free food pantry, emergency utility and housing assistance, budgeting and nutrition counseling, SNAP enrollment.

Bergen.name: Center for Food Action – Mahwah
Bergen.notes: Free groceries, household items, personal care products.

Bergen.name: Center for Food Action – Carlstadt
Bergen.notes: Serves Carlstadt, East Rutherford, Lyndhurst, Rutherford, North Arlington, Wood-Ridge.

Bergen.name: Center for Food Action – Saddle Brook
Center for Food Action – Palisades Park
Faith Reformed Church
Bergen.notes: Emergency food bank and soup kitchen.

Bergen.name: Helping Hands of Teaneck
Bergen.notes: Free dry and canned goods, paper products, holiday meal groceries, baby formula.

Bergen.name: Jewish Family Services of Bergen County
Bergen.notes: Emergency food and financial help, scholarship referrals. Serves immigrants and refugees.

Bergen.name: St. Francis de Sales
Bergen.notes: Shelf stable milk, fruits, vegetables, rice, pasta.

Bergen.name: All Access Community Development
Bergen.notes: Surplus commodities, Meals on Wheels referrals. Assists immigrants.

Bergen.name: The Food Brigade
Bergen.notes: Client-choice 'Community Market' food pantry. Also serves Hudson and Passaic counties.

Bergen.name: Greater Bergen Community Action Agency
Bergen.notes: Soup kitchen, employment assistance, SNAP enrollment, WIC vouchers.

Bergen.name: Family Promise of Bergen County
Bergen.notes: Primarily serves working homeless families with children.

Bergen.name: Faith and Hope Food Pantry at Christ Church
Bergen.notes: Canned meats, personal hygiene items, soup, pasta, baby formula, Ensure for seniors.

Bergen.name: Salvation Army – Englewood

Bergen.name: St Joseph's Church
Bergen.notes: Food, referrals, Christmas and Thanksgiving meals.

Bergen.name: Epiphany Roman Catholic Church / Cliffside Park Borough Hall
Bergen.notes: Services Cliffside Park, Fairview, Edgewater, Fort Lee.

Bergen.name: St. Margaret of Cortona Food Pantry
Bergen.notes: Non-perishable food.

Bergen.name: Holy Rosary Church Pantry
Bergen.notes: Combined with Meals on Wheels for seniors and homebound.

Bergen.name: St. John The Baptist Church Food Pantry
Lyndhurst Food Pantry

Bergen.name: Calvary Baptist Food and Clothing Pantry
Bergen.notes: Clothing for work and school, holiday meals and gifts.

Essex.name: Iglesia Pentecostal El Paraiso
Essex.notes: Provides 3–4 bags of food (milk, juice, eggs, canned goods).

Gloucester.name: Alliances of Empowerment in Housing (Hope Mobile)

Gloucester.name: South Jersey Dream Center
Gloucester.notes: Curbside pickup by appointment only. Groceries and baby items.

Mercer.name: Mercer Street Friends – Ewing
Mercer.notes: Only serves Mercer County residents. WIC and food stamp referrals.

Mercer.name: Crisis Ministry of Princeton and Trenton
Mercer.notes: Hot meals, lunch, clothing, diapers, material assistance.

Passaic.name: Center for Food Action – Upper Passaic Appointment Distribution
Passaic.hours: Once every three weeks, by appointment
Passaic.notes: Box of non-perishable food plus fresh produce, meat, dairy, and bread as available. Login or call to request an appointment.

Passaic.name: Eva's Village – Community Kitchen
Passaic.hours: Breakfast Mon–Fri 8:30AM; Lunch Mon–Fri 12:00PM & 1:00PM; Sat–Sun Lunch 12:00PM
Passaic.notes: Hot meals served daily. Also offers shelter, recovery, and social services.

Somerset.name: Franklin Township Food Bank
Somerset.notes: Serves Franklin Township area. Partners with local churches and charities. Fresh fruits, frozen foods.

Sussex.name: Sussex County Division of Social Services
Sussex.notes: Non-perishable food items, hygiene products, and pet food (when available).

Warren.name: Washington Community Food Pantry
Warren.address: 40 East Church Street (First Presbyterian Church of Washington)
Warren.notes: Call to confirm eligibility before visiting.
